def band(o,arm):
 v=o.asset.mesh[0];out=[]
 for x in [0.,-.02,.02]:
  p=v[(abs(v[:,0]-x)<.012)&(v[:,2]>.075)]
  if len(p)<5:continue
  lo,hi=p.min(0),p.max(0)
  for ax in [2,1]:
   closing=o.R[:,ax]
   approach=o.R[:,1 if ax==2 else 2]
   if approach[2]>0:approach=-approach
   centre=(hi+lo)*.5;centre[0]=x
   out.append(G.Grasp('bridge',T_from(o.R@centre+o.pos,G._frame(approach,closing)),float(hi[ax]-lo[ax]),note=f'bridge {x} axis{ax}'))
 return out
for mode in MODES:
 blocked=[]
 def staged(self,arm,q0,T_goal,step_rad=.06,name="move",gripper=1.,ignore=(),held=None,**kw):
  if mode not in ("staged", "settled", "cup", "retry", "dense") or name != "place_approach" or held is None or held.label != "headset":
   return original_motion(self,arm,q0,T_goal,step_rad,name,gripper,ignore,held,**kw)
  now=self.kin.tcp(arm,q0)@held.T_tcp_obj
  mid=T_goal@held.T_tcp_obj
  mid[:2,3]=now[:2,3]
  mid[2,3]=max(mid[2,3],now[2,3])
  T_mid=mid@inv_T(held.T_tcp_obj)
  a=original_motion(self,arm,q0,T_mid,step_rad,"clear_rotate",gripper,ignore,held,**kw)
  if not a.ok:return a
  b=self.line(arm,a.q_end,T_goal,step_rad,"upright_carry",gripper=gripper,ignore=ignore,held=held,check=True)
  return a.then(b)

  if mode=="settled" and pp.label=="headset":kw["tol_xy"]=.02
  grasp_obj=inv_T(pp.T_tcp_obj)
  r=original_run(self,pp,pl,**kw)
  if mode=='retry' and r.status=='loose':blocked.append(grasp_obj)
  return r
 Skills.run_transfer=run_transfer

  if label=='headset':
   if mode=='retry' and blocked:
    old=kw['grasps'];o=self.world.obj(label)
    kw['grasps']=lambda arm: [g for g in old(arm) if not any(np.linalg.norm((inv_T(o.T)@g.T)[:3,3]-b[:3,3])<.025 and abs((inv_T(o.T)@g.T)[:3,1]@b[:3,1])>.8 for b in blocked)]

    kw['max_full']=24

    kw['pair_rank']=lambda g,*a: 0. if (inv_T(o.T)@g.T)[2,3] < o.asset.bbox_min[2]+.05 else 50.

    kw['lift_to_pre']=True

    kw['grasps']=lambda arm:band(self.world.obj(label),arm)
    kw['pick_kw']={'squeeze':8};kw['max_full']=24
  result=original(self,label,targets,**kw)
